name: Sprite, Bolt

abilities.name: Conductive
abilities.description: A bolt sprite’s slam attack deals electric damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes flat- footed until the start of the bolt sprite's next turn.

abilities.name: Starburst
abilities.description: When reduced to 0 HP or the bottom of the Break Gauge, the bolt sprite makes an attack roll (d20+11), at no penalty, against the Ref Defence of all adjacent creatures. If successful, targets take 1d6+1 electric damage. Otherwise, targets take half damage. The bolt sprite is then destroyed. This is an area effect.

steal: Ice Crystal (5%), Magicite (95%) Elementals Echoes of the old gods, these strange beings manifest from the raw magickal power that remains in the world long after the primals were sealed away. Elementals progress as beasts. However, they gain an amount of MP equal to 3+ Mnd (minimum 1) at each level and always treat Spellcraft as a class skill. Additionally, elementals cannot be knocked prone. Lastly, when reduced to 0 HP or the bottom of the Break Gauge, elementals are destroyed, leaving no corpse behind.

name: Flan, Static
description: Mischievous slimes that delight in toying with their prey—often with a shocking surprise.

abilities.name: Bubble
abilities.description: As a primary action, a static flan can make an attack roll (d20+15) against the Ref Defence of a target within 6 squares and line of sight. If successful, the target becomes drenched. Should the attack roll beat both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target is also knocked prone. The static flan may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

abilities.name: Conductive
abilities.description: A static flan’s slam attack deals electric damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes flat- footed until the start of the static flan's next turn.

name: Pudding, Chilled
description: Cold slimes with warm hearts, burdened by deep sorrow, as everything they embrace withers slowly and dies.

abilities.name: Bubble
abilities.description: As a primary action, a chilled pudding can make an attack (d20+17) against the Ref Defence of a target within 6 squares and line of sight. If successful, the target becomes drenched. Should the attack roll beat both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target is also knocked prone. The chilled pudding may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.description: A chilled pudding’s slam attack deals cold damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target’s movement is reduced to 2 squares until the start of the chilled pudding's next turn.

name: Ooze, Molten
description: Volatile slimes so aggressive, they even fight among themselves.

abilities.name: Burn
abilities.description: A molten ooze’s slam attack deals fire damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target takes an additional 1d6 fire damage at the start of its next turn, before taking any other action. This damage ignores DR.

abilities.name: Sludge
abilities.description: As a primary action, a molten ooze can make an attack (d20+17) against the Ref Defence of a target within 6 squares and line of sight. If successful, the target becomes oiled. Should the attack roll beat both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target is also knocked prone. The molten ooze may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

name: Djinn, Earth
languages: Primordial Serene spirits that linger in quiet watch over the ancient ruins of Al-Sabrah.
description: Serene spirits that linger in quiet watch over the ancient ruins of Al-Sabrah.

abilities.name: Tremor
abilities.description: As a primary action, an earth djinn can make an attack (d20+19) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 6 square cone. If successful, creatures take 6d6+9 blunt damage and are knocked prone. Otherwise, creatures take half damage and are not knocked prone. The earth djinn may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This does not affect creatures with hover. This is an area effect and the secondary effect is a stun.

abilities.name: Unction
abilities.description: Whenever the earth djinn’s slam attack beats both a target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes oiled.

name: Djinn, Fire
languages: Primordial Brief-lived spirits, burning fiercely and fading quickly.
description: Brief-lived spirits, burning fiercely and fading quickly.

abilities.name: Burn
abilities.description: A fire djinn’s slam attack deals fire damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target’s Ref and Fort Defence, the target takes an additional 2d6 fire damage at the start of its next turn, before taking any other action. This damage ignores DR.

abilities.name: Firebolt
abilities.description: As a primary action, a fire djinn may make an attack (d20+17) against the Ref defence of a target within 6 squares and line of sight. If successful, the target takes 6d6+7 fire damage. Otherwise, the target takes half damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beat the Ref Defence of any creatures adjacent to the target, they take half that damage. The fire djinn may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

name: Djinn, Thunder
languages: Primordial Once sacred spirits of Lynuria, now scorned for their wild and vexing nature.
description: Once sacred spirits of Lynuria, now scorned for their wild and vexing nature.

abilities.name: Conductive
abilities.description: A thunder djinn’s slam attack deals electric damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target’s Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes flat- footed until the start of the thunder djinn’s next turn.

abilities.name: Forked Lightning
abilities.description: As a primary action, the thunder djinn can make an attack (d20+19) against the Ref Defence of up to 5 creatures within a 6 square cone. If successful, targets take 6d6+9 electric damage. Otherwise, targets take half damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beat both a target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes paralysed. The thunder djinn may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

name: Djinn, Frost
languages: Primordial Spirits as cold and unfeeling as the Dread himself.
description: Spirits as cold and unfeeling as the Dread himself.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: As a primary action, a frost djinn can make an attack (d20+20) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 6 square cone. If successful, creatures take 6d6+10 cold damage. Otherwise, creatures take half damage. Additionally, should the roll beat both a creature’s Ref and Fort Defence, the creature loses their secondary action on their next turn. The frost djinn may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.description: A frost djinn’s slam attack deals cold damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target’s Ref and Fort Defence, the target’s movement is reduced to 2 squares until the start of the frost djinn’s next turn.

name: Titan, Rock
languages: Primordial Majestic giants roaming the Highlands’ mountains, rumored gentler than their kin—though few live to confirm it.
description: Majestic giants roaming the Highlands’ mountains, rumored gentler than their kin—though few live to confirm it.

abilities.name: Earthquake
abilities.description: As an all-out action, a rock titan may make an attack (d20+26) against the Ref Defence of all enemies within its reach. If successful, targets suffer 8d6+16 blunt damage. Otherwise, creatures take half damage. Additionally, should the attack roll beat both a target's Ref and Fort Defence, they become flat-footed on their next turn. Should the attack beat a target's Fort Defence by 5 or more, the target is knocked prone. The rock titan may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This does not affect creatures with hover. This is an area effect and the secondary effect is a stun.

abilities.name: Immovable
abilities.description: A rock titan cannot be moved by any means of forced movement, including teleportation.

abilities.name: Imposing
abilities.description: A rock titan may add its Str modifier to all Persuasion checks made to intimidate.

abilities.name: Unction
abilities.description: Whenever the rock titan’s slam attack beats both a target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes oiled.

abilities.description: As an all-out action, a lava titan may make an attack (d20+25) against the Ref Defence of all enemies within its reach. If successful, targets suffer 6d6+15 fire damage. Additionally, should the attack roll beat both a target's Ref and Fort Defence, they take 1/2 the damage dealt at the start of their next turn and 1/4 the damage dealt at the start of their following turn.
